}}'''Lairain''' is an [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Brown Ajah]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Lairain}}

== Appearance ==
She is short and toad-like. She has curly hair.{{ref/book|12|46}}

== History ==
It is likely that she is a librarian, as [[Egwene al'Vere]] thinks of her as one of the Brown sisters who spent her life "roaming the back library stacks and only surfaced once a century or so to recite instructions to prospective [[Amyrlin Seat|Amyrlins]]".{{ref/book|12|46}} Once a century is likely an exaggeration, but the rest is possibly true. 

== Activities ==
She instructs Egwene on the proper procedure when going through the raising of a new [[Amyrlin Seat]]. Egwene had never met her before.{{ref/book|12|46}}
